correctness.rationale: Both maps are explicitly defined on orthonormal bases. Their images are disjoint, cover every target basis vector, and have nonzero scalar ≤1, proving boundedness, injectivity and density. Direct coordinate computations yield exact W*PW=Q and V*QV=P. Non-invertibility follows from the positive spectral gap in the Calkin quotient of any invertible congruence of projection-plus-compact P versus the infinitely-many essential eigenvalues of Q tending to zero; finite exact tests corroborate, not replace, these infinite proofs.
